text:
anya: FYI — external pen test scheduled by RedTeamCo on 2024-04-10. Need to finalize scope, intake, remediation tracker, and retest windows. Who can own intake and SLAs?

samir: I'll own intake + triage. Can we use the pen-test tracker sheet? link: https://redwood/internal/pen-test-tracker (private)

julie: Scope question — do we include Hosted API, Dedicated, Private (VPC/on-prem)? Vendor asked for network ingress tests for private customers.

michael: We should exclude customer-managed on-prem unless customer has signed data-share. For dedicated pools, I'll provide node inventory + image hashes by EOD 2024-03-15.

samir: Created tracker and ticket via security-bot. See below.

security-bot: Ticket created: PENTEST-3245. Tracker: https://redwood/internal/pen-test-tracker/PENTEST-3245

ops-oncall: Heads-up — we'll need a deploy freeze on retest dates. TL;DR: no prod deploys 2024-04-12 -> 2024-04-14 unless emergency.

anya: Proposed remediation SLA by severity: Critical = 7 days, High = 30 days, Medium = 90 days. Agree?

julie: Agree for Critical/High. For RCE we should aim 48 hours follow-up for mitigation.

samir: Quick triage snapshot:
```
ID  | Severity | Component     | Owner     | Status             | Target retest
001 | Critical | Hosted API    | julie     | Acknowledged       | 2024-04-13
002 | High     | Dedicated GP  | michael   | In progress        | 2024-04-20
003 | Medium   | Console       | ops-oncall| TODO               | 2024-05-01
```

julie: Vendor POC is emma@redteamco.com. For retest request template:
```
Hello Emma,
Please confirm retest window for finding 001 on 2024-04-13 09:00-12:00 UTC. We will have oncall + owner available.
Thanks, Julie
```

anya: OK. Actions:
- samir: finalize tracker + attach vuln report (due today)
- michael: inventory + image hashes (due 2024-03-15)
- julie: prepare mitigation plan for 001 (due 2024-03-18)
- ops-oncall: block retest deploy windows with SRE (done)
We'll have weekly sync on Wednesdays 10am PT starting 2024-03-20.

security-bot: PENTEST-3245 status updated to "Remediation in progress" by samir

ops-oncall: noted. I've added SRE rotation to the ticket and blocked calendars :calendar: 

samir: attaching initial vendor report to ticket now.

anya: thanks all. Keep status updates in the ticket thread; ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
